scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
KeekeekeeKeheheh.
This is amazing!
The results are extraordinary!!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
KeekeekeeKeheheh.
太棒了！實驗結果簡直超乎想像！！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Using my skills in this distant
land was unexpected...
Keheheh... The lord of palace
was quite accomodating.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
沒想到能在這遙遠的地方施展我的技藝...
Keheheh...宮殿的主人倒是挺通情達理。

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Oops, I better be careful...
If the guild finds out my
location, stupid Myster will
get mad at me. Kehehehkeh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
哎呀，得小心...
要是公會發現我的行蹤，那個笨蛋米斯特准會生氣。Kehehehkeh...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
What? Wanna say something?
If you are here for tourism,
enjoy your day off, then go back to your hometown.
Keekeekee... Or else,
I will let you taste my acid bottle...!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
怎麼？有話要說？
來旅遊的話，玩夠了就回老家去。
Keekeekee...不然，就讓你嚐嚐我的鹽酸瓶...！

scripts.text: Please, excuse me
scripts.translation: 請原諒我

scripts.text: Do you need help?
scripts.translation: 您需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh... Did you hear
what I said? It would be
better to forget...
Keekeekeekeekee...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
Keheheh...聽見我剛才說的話了？最好忘掉...
Keekeekeekeekee...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Help, eh?...
Now that I think about it...
I need some items right now...
Keeheeheekeehee...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
幫忙？...
這麼一說，我現在還真需要些材料...
Keeheeheekeehee...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Sir Laspuchin needs some
enchant stones for an experiment.
I will use it efficiently...
Do you have them now?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
拉斯普欽大人需要些屬性原石做實驗。
我會好好利用的...
你身上有嗎？

scripts.text: Nope
scripts.translation: 沒有

scripts.text: I got some
scripts.translation: 我有

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Then, find 8 stones of one kind.
If you bring 8 of one kind of
enchant stones, I will change it
to a better one...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
那就找8個同一種類的屬性原石來，我能幫你換成更好的...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Then, find 8 stones of one kind.
not the round gemstones but
enchant stones.
If you bring the wrong stones,
I will throw a flame bottle!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
去找8個同一種類的石頭。
我要屬性原石，不是圓圓的寶石。
帶錯了，我就扔火煙瓶！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Bring me stones, slave~!!
And keep your promise! Kehehehkehkeh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
把石頭帶來，奴隸~！！
記住你的承諾！Kehehehkehkeh...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Uh-huh, what did you bring?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
嗯哼，你帶了什麼來？

scripts.text: Mystic Frozen
scripts.translation: 水靈原石

scripts.text: Great Nature
scripts.translation: 土靈原石

scripts.text: Flame Heart
scripts.translation: 火靈原石

scripts.text: Rough Wind
scripts.translation: 風靈原石

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
I will take 8 of them and
give you an enchant stone.
How's that sound?
Keheheh.....
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
我收下8個，給你1個屬性原石，怎麼樣？
Keheheh.....

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
You can't help Laspuchin with just a couple
of enchant stones... I said 8!
Bring me just 8 stones!
Keheheh.....
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
就這幾顆屬性原石，可幫不了拉斯普欽大人...我說的是8個！
帶8個來！
Keheheh.....

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh~ Check your pockets
before you tell me
how foolish you are.....
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
Keheheh~先檢查口袋，別急著讓我知道你有多蠢...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
HeeHee, what do you want? Choose one!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
HeeHee，想要什麼？選一個！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Oh, well.
Don't tell anyone about my location...
Keheheh...after all, you did promise~
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
好吧。
別告訴任何人我在哪裡...
Keheheh...你可是答應過的~

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Kehhehheh, You know something?
I don't have many of those
so I'm going to take ^0000FF12^000000 of yours, okay?
Of course, it is okay.
It is an honor to help Laspuchin!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
Kehhehheh，你知道嗎？這東西我存貨不多，所以得收你^0000FF12^000000個，沒意見吧？
當然沒意見，能幫拉斯普欽大人可是你的榮幸！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh, You know something.
I don't have many of these so
I can't just get 8 of yours.
If you want to change them to Rough Wind,
bring me 4 more stones. 8 + 4 = 12...
Requires ^0000FF12^000000 stones.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
Keheheh，這東西存貨不多，收8個可不行。
想換風靈原石，就再帶4個來。
8 + 4 = 12...要^0000FF12^000000個石頭。

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh! You've chosen a good one!
Use it well...
Bring me other stones if you have them!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
Keheheh!選得不錯！
好好利用它...
還有別的石頭，就帶來吧！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Bring me stones, slave~!!
And keep your promise! Kehheheheheh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
把石頭帶來，奴隸~！！
記住你的承諾！Kehheheheheh...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Bring me stones, slave~!!
And keep your promise! Keheheheheh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
把石頭帶來，奴隸~！！
記住你的承諾！Keheheheheh...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Bring me stones! You said you are going to help me!
Keep your promises! Kehehehkehkeh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普欽·格雷戈裡]
把石頭帶來！你說過要幫我的！
記住你的承諾！Kehehehkehkeh...
